system.effect: Official ID carrying a geas: viewers do not question the bearer's identity or authority, and can be ordered to forget or stay silent.
system.description: A field agent's most essential item, inscribed with a powerful compulsion sigil. Works on anyone who has not signed the Official Secrets Act in blood and on lower-ranked signatories, and controls Residual Human Resources. Abuse is a serious offence investigated by the Auditors. Issued to all operatives.
